title: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan not enthused about opening 2026 season in Australia: 'We'll deal with it'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan not enthused about opening 2026 season in Australia: 'We'll deal with it'
sources.description: Local time in Melbourne, Australia, is 15 hours ahead of the U.S. Eastern time zone. So kickoff for the 49ers-Rams game will be at 10:35 a.m local time on Friday, Sept. 11.
